title: First 90 days
summary: Systems on autopilot: home lease signed, routines set, and the fog lifting.

items.title: Sign a longer-term lease (or renew serviced)
items.detail: Understand LOI vs Tenancy Agreement, diplomatic clause, inventory list, and deposit return conditions before you stamp. IRAS lease duty is typically 0.4% of total rent for leases of four years or less — stamp within 14 days if signed in Singapore.

items.title: Transfer utilities and fibre
items.detail: SP Group account, water, and fibre/broadband in your name. Photograph meter readings on move-in day.

items.title: Sketch your tax residency timeline + filing season
items.detail: IRAS tax residency often hinges on days present and employment. Note your arrival date; open myTax Portal once Singpass works. Use the tax-residency day sketch for the common ≥183-day calendar-year test. YA 2026 e-Filing runs 1 Mar–18 Apr 2026 — put it on the calendar even in your first year.

items.title: Skim the between-jobs playbook once
items.detail: If you ever change employers without leaving Singapore, STVP timing, Dependant Pass fall-through, and IR21-vs-rehire rules matter more than LinkedIn. Keep the sequence bookmarked before you need it.

items.title: Save emergency and embassy contacts
items.detail: 995 (ambulance/fire), 999 (police), your embassy/high commission, and building security. Share with household members.

items.title: Lock school / childcare and holiday care
items.detail: Confirm term dates against the MOE and international-school calendars. If targeting mainstream schools, track AEIS (Jul/Sep) and S-AEIS (Jan/Mar) windows. Book a backup carer for public holidays and June / year-end breaks when schools close and offices do not.

items.title: Complete baseline health checks
items.detail: Dental, optometry, and any chronic-condition specialists. Panel networks differ — call your insurer first.

items.title: Join one recurring community
items.detail: Club, faith group, sports team, or parents’ WhatsApp. Recurring is the point — one-off mixers fade.

items.title: Calendar your pass expiry minus 6 months
items.detail: EP renewals and COMPASS evidence take lead time. Put a reminder now while the issue date is fresh — and note MOM’s qualifying-salary tables shift again from 1 Jan 2027 for new applications.

items.title: Skim the leaving playbook once
items.detail: Even if you are staying — IR21 tax clearance (employer files ≥1 month ahead; STVP up to 90 days on cancel), deposit timelines, and shipping lead times are easier when you know they exist.
